clinical_reasoning_summary: The patient’s multimorbid profile is dominated by severe hyperlipidaemia, obesity, prediabetes, and uncontrolled hypertension. Review of the evidence supports heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia as the principal driver of ASCVD risk, amplified by metabolic syndrome. Co‑existing conditions that further increase cardiovascular risk include NAFLD, obstructive sleep apnea, and early chronic kidney disease. Mental‑health burden, possible obstructive airway disease, and opioid dependence are also plausible contributors but carry lower certainty.
